purpose.objective: Reorganize academy repositories and autonomous execution around evidence-qualified canonical modules, stable identities, environment-specific native harnesses and accountable Work ownership, preserving existing owners and completed work.
successCriteria: Measured scoped host, container, source, worktree and runtime capabilities have explicit source pins and unknowns.
Repository/module canonical ownership, dependency rules and consumer migration are reviewable and preserve historical references.
Identity continuity, Work/Task DAG, single-tab accountability, shared-resource serialization and review gates are explicit.
A separately approved independent Astra/xhigh review guides staged implementation and meaningful verification.
Implementation, source verification, integration, native activation and teacher/user acceptance remain distinct.
inScope: Typed English architecture, canonical local Work records and approval-first independent review design.
After architecture approval and review disposition, staged source implementation using existing maintained owners.
outOfScope: Publication, PR, merge, deployment, native activation, real student writes, prints or sends under the retained hold.
Common contract, permission or unrelated Work changes without separate owner/user approval.
Credential inspection, private student original ingestion into architecture, source retirement or native loop replacement.
Taking over research/Ontology/Wiki semantics or unrelated runtime lifecycle.

content.inventoryScope: No operational effects consumed or proposed in this architecture-only Work phase. Prior Work effect inventories remain owned and must be qualified before dependent execution; empty local inventory does not clear them.
content.acceptedEarlierDirection: Preserve existing source, code, data, semantic and native owners; consolidate context/execution contracts and perform whole-target design followed by workflow-by-workflow replacement.
content.priorHold: No publication, merge, deployment, activation or additional third-session messages.
content.latestStudentContext: The user-supplied October19 context supersedes older applicable student claims; student bodies stay private and are not copied here.
